sources.research_question: Find global versioning and integration-model changes
sources.review_note: Published change statements, not independently verified release behavior. The broader change index is not a completed migration.

sources.research_question: Compare the linked versioned guide with its unversioned representation
sources.review_note: Equality is confined to these two captured bodies. In M02 the offboarding branch ends with an onboarding label; intended correction is not established. No webhook handler was run and these diagrams do not establish production deletion policy.

sources.research_question: Connect workflow validation notice to applicability and migration action
sources.review_note: The published notice is inspected, not executed or independently deployment-verified. Full date-based migration guidance remains unread.

sources.research_question: Distinguish compatibility policy from feature-specific migration
sources.review_note: A platform policy does not establish whether a particular invoice-financing integration is affected or supply a feature-specific migration.

sources.research_question: Actionable diagnosis of stale, incomplete or failed data
sources.review_note: This sampled page covers one warning category. It does not supply universal stale-data recovery or safe-to-ignore rules for every lending workflow.

sources.research_question: Version boundary, migration steps and compatibility scope
sources.review_note: Policy and examples are inspected only. A version selector cannot establish the separate event contract or complete an integration migration.

sources.research_question: Integration-model-specific token guidance
sources.review_note: Provider-specific behavior; no token requests were made. mTLS/JOSE setup and each partner entitlement remain outside this trace.

sources.research_question: Test account setup and limits; check applicability beyond AI example
sources.review_note: The article is an AI/workflow example, not a REST record-and-association test plan. Only setup and test-boundary passages support this observation; broad safety claims elsewhere are not adopted. No account was created.

sources.research_question: Connect failure signal to transient, permanent and escalated recovery actions
sources.review_note: Simulation was not run. A provider-retry code is not authorization for caller retries; missing failure events do not establish success. Full financial reconciliation is still untraced.
